cohort: The study included all women in France who gave birth after 22 weeks of gestation between September 16 and December 31, 2024, with RSVpreF-vaccinated women matched 1:1 to unvaccinated women.
finding: The study found no significant increase in the risk of preterm birth, stillbirth, SGA birth weight, postpartum hemorrhage, preeclampsia, or major adverse cardiovascular events associated with RSVpreF vaccination during pregnancy.
mod_finding: There was no significant increase in the risk of cesarean delivery (weighted IRR 1.00, 95% CI, 0.96-1.03) associated with RSVpreF vaccination.
